name: Tomato Bath
summary: A Karnataka-style tomato bath prepared with sona masuri rice, tomatoes, whole spices, peas, garam masala and lemon.

name: Vangi Bath
summary: Karnataka-style brinjal rice with capsicum and vangi bath powder.

name: Curd Rice
summary: Soft, cooling curd rice designed for a small portion and a very soft texture.

name: Jeera Rice
summary: Simple onion jeera rice made with sona masuri rice, cumin, whole spices, onion and ghee in a pressure cooker.

name: Garlic Butter Rice
summary: Mild garlic butter rice made with separately cooked sona masuri rice, lightly golden garlic, spring onion, pepper and optional herbs.

name: Mushroom Vegetable Pepper Sauté
summary: Dry glossy mushroom vegetable pepper sauté with crisp-tender mixed vegetables, butter, garlic, pepper, chilli vinegar and no cornflour.

name: Mango Rice
summary: Karnataka-style mavinakayi chitranna made with separately cooked rice, grated raw mango, tempering, peanuts or cashews, coconut powder, and coriander.

name: Veg Pulao
summary: South Indian veg pulao with basmati rice, mixed vegetables, capsicum, gedde kosu and a coriander-only masala paste.

name: Dal Khichdi (Pan-Mixed Version)
summary: Soft pan-mixed dal khichdi made with moong dal, rice, frozen peas, onion-tomato masala, cumin, coriander and butter.

name: Tomato Rasam
summary: A quick tomato rasam made with rasam powder, pressure-cooked tomatoes and garlic tempering.

name: Rustic Pepper Jeera Tomato Rasam
summary: A rustic tomato rasam made with freshly ground jeera, coriander seeds, pepper, garlic, tomato and Indira tamarind paste.

name: Balekai Palya
summary: Karnataka-style raw banana stir fry with simple tempering, coconut and coriander.

name: Beetroot Palya
summary: Simple Karnataka-style beetroot palya with green chilli, tempering, jaggery, and either coconut powder or fresh grated coconut.

name: Alasande Kayi Palya
summary: Sringeri-side inspired alasande kayi palya with a reddish-brown roasted coconut masala, tamarind, and jaggery, cooked semi-moist for mixing with plain rice.

name: Beans Palya
summary: Classic Karnataka-style beans palya with onion, tempering, and fresh coconut.

name: Pumpkin Palya
summary: Karnataka-style pumpkin palya with onion, green chilli, simple tempering, fresh coconut and coriander.

name: Fusion Mixed Vegetable Palya
summary: Dry Karnataka-style fusion mixed vegetable palya with potato, onion, tomato, beans, carrot, peas, sweet corn, mild spices, lemon and optional coconut.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
summary: Karnataka-style bisi bele bath made with rice, toor dal, mixed vegetables, bisi bele bath powder and tamarind.

name: Menthya Rice Bath
summary: Karnataka-style methi rice bath made with sona masuri rice, fresh methi leaves, whole spices, tamarind and jaggery.

name: Punjabi Dal Tadka
summary: Punjabi dhaba-style dal tadka made with toor dal, moong dal, onion, tomato, garlic, ghee and a spicy kasuri methi tempering.

name: Homemade Muesli
summary: Homemade muesli with roasted oats, wheat flakes, nuts, seeds, puffed amaranth and dried fruits.
